title: Build a string from letters
prompt:
Write `CanBuildString(source, target string) bool`: can `target` be built from the letters of `source`? Each letter of `source` can be used at most once. Letters are runes and may be Cyrillic.

`("aabbc", "abca")` → `true`, `("abc", "aa")` → `false`
hint: Count the runes of `source` in a map, then spend them while ranging over `target`.
